items.title: 56679_Arthur Briggs oral history interview
items.q: we gave a concert. It was more or less a Beethoven festival.

ctx.x: And I guess that's one of the reasons why I'm here today. Of course, my wife came to see me whenever she could, and she brought me a hot meal, whenever she could, as well.
But, by, (in a while) we had the Commandant of Paris, it came up and we gave a concert. It was more or less a Beethoven festival.
